CODE
Art. 2.3.72. 
Maximum amount of the participation claim 
The participation claim is limited to half the value of the debtor spouse's acquisitions as they exist, after deduction of debts, on the date used to determine the amount of this claim.
The limit of the participation claim is increased by half of the amount added to the final assets in application of Article 2.3.68, ¤ 2, with the exception of the case referred to in subparagraph 1, 1¡, b), of the same paragraph.
